about_the_game:
Prologue


Every story has its beginnings. In this 60-90 minute introductory chapter discover the disturbing event Omar witnesses that sets him on his journey to the mysterious town in the hills of West Virginia.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains blood, physical violence, profanity, tobacco use, substance abuse, and written descriptions of self harm.
